repos_data.description: Apple Mail MCP server with full-coverage FTS5 body search. Reliable on large mailboxes where AppleScript-based servers timeout.

Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that give AI agents local access to macOS apps: Mail, Calendar, Reminders, Messages, Contacts, Notes, Shortcuts, Files, System, and Maps. Unified server plus focused single-app servers.
MCP server for Apple Mail: sub-ms search over 300k+ messages via Mail's own SQLite index, verified sends, Exchange body backfill, triage plan/review/apply. 849 tests, MIT.
Copy 2FA codes on your Mac with one shortcut: verification codes from Mail and Messages plus a built-in TOTP/HOTP authenticator. Free, open source, no internet access.
MCP server for iCloud Mail over IMAP/SMTP — search every folder, read, draft, send, flag and file your Apple mail. Runs locally, no third party.
Local macOS MCP suite: 133 tools for Apple apps, iWork, files, media, and allowlisted Shortcuts.
